overloadPatches.semanticRole: Sets (adding if not present) one or more attribute name/value pairs on the XML element elementRef, converting non-Text attrValue values to text.

constraints: attrValue may be Text or another scalar type (Boolean, Integer, Real, Date, Time); non-Text values are converted to text (e.g. Boolean -> "true"/"false", Date -> RFC 3339 string, Time -> number of seconds as text).
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close
